result.summary: Independently re-verified the ISS-503 flake fix on feature/ADHOC-iss503-infra-20260730 @ d7aa615 (confirmed checked out locally, 1 commit ahead of origin/feature/ADHOC-iss503-infra-20260730). Read tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig in full: TC-ISS503-02 and TC-ISS503-03 each open one transaction (BEGIN), register `errdefer conn.exec("ROLLBACK", &.{}) catch {}` immediately, run the tenant-mode-flip UPDATE + GBL-084 DDL apply(es) + all assertions inside it via `try`, and end with an unconditional explicit ROLLBACK on the success path. Grepped the whole file for COMMIT: zero occurrences -- there is no code path in either test that can commit. Any `try` failure mid-sequence triggers the errdefer's ROLLBACK; even the fallback case of the connection being closed without either ROLLBACK executing cannot commit, since pg.zig's Conn.close() (vendor/pg/pg.zig:124) only sends a Terminate message and closes the socket -- Postgres itself aborts any open transaction on connection termination, it never auto-commits. GBL-084's DDL (ALTER TABLE / DROP POLICY / DROP COLUMN / DROP FUNCTION) is ordinary transactional DDL, so ROLLBACK provably undoes both the temporary storage_mode flip and the migration DDL, leaving zero persisted residue on the shared public.tenant row or any business table. TC-ISS503-01 (own per-test-UUID tenant row + defer cleanup) and TC-ISS503-04 (own per-test-UUID process_definitions row, explicit CRUD lifecycle including its own DELETE) are unchanged and correct -- neither reads nor writes another test's fixture. Ran `python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig`: OK, no isolation issues. Independently ran `zig build test-integration-iss503 --summary all` in a fresh 10-iteration bash loop (BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test, matching the live db_test container's actual port mapping, not the stale 5433 from .env.example): all 10 iterations printed exactly 'Build Summary: 5/5 steps succeeded; 4/4 tests passed' with exit code 0 -- 10/10 clean, zero FAIL lines. Ran `zig build test-integration-tm --summary all` once: 'Build Summary: 5/5 steps succeeded; 14/14 tests passed', exit 0 -- ISS-504 regression gate holds. Cross-checked docs/anti-patterns.md's 'Shared mutable tenant or fixture state across integration test blocks' entry: the correct-approach text requires fixtures created by one test not be read/modified by another and cleaned up via defer even on failure. The new approach goes further than that minimum bar -- it makes the shared-fixture read provably non-persistent via unconditional transactional rollback, which is the documented alternative in spirit (own nothing beyond your own transaction), not a different flavor of the same anti-pattern; no other test in the file, and no subsequent invocation of the binary, can observe any trace of TC-02/03's activity. Re-confirmed DIRECTIVE T-1 / SkipZigTest / per-test-UUID / clear-failure-on-missing-BPM_TEST_DB_URL checklist: zero `error.SkipZigTest` occurrences in the file; testDbUrl() returns error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl with a printed message if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent (no silent skip); TC-01/04 use randomUuidStr() for their own fixtures; all allocations are paired with defer/errdefer frees per the linter. No new problems found. Gate re-confirmed solid enough to finalize.
